function.name: resolve
function.description: Find which matter a spoken name refers to. Call this before check_rules or draft_approval, which both need an id. Pass the matter name ONLY, with no surrounding words: say 'Apex litigation', not 'tomorrow's Apex deposition'. Returns a verdict of unique, ambiguous or none, with ranked candidates. Only act on unique; otherwise read the candidate names out and ask which was meant.

phrase.description: the matter name alone, for example 'Apex litigation'

kind.description: use 'task' to search matters only; omit to search both

function.name: check_rules
function.description: Read the client's Outside Counsel Guidelines for one matter and report what they say about the proposed work. Returns a finding, a summary to read out, the section it came from, and any fields still missing. This is the only source of a citation -- never state a section number that did not come from here.

category.description: timekeeper_attendance for who may work on or attend something; expert_retention for engaging an expert, consultant or vendor; travel_time for billing travel; expense_threshold for a disbursement

person.description: the timekeeper or the expert, when the question is about one

hours.description: estimated hours, if the lawyer gave one

amount_dollars.description: estimated cost in dollars, if the lawyer gave one

days_ahead.description: 0 for today, 1 for tomorrow. An approval only counts if it was decided before the work.

function.name: draft_approval
function.description: Write an approval request for work that check_rules said needs one. Call it only after the lawyer says yes. Pass the same arguments you passed to check_rules. Returns the recipient, subject and body. Nothing is sent -- say so.

category.description: the same category you passed to check_rules

person.description: the timekeeper or expert the request is about
